summary: This week in AI, major advancements were seen in robotics and LLMs. Companies like Google and Meta are investing heavily in AI infrastructure, while others like Anthropic are dealing with security breaches. The industry is also seeing a rise in personal AI agents and AI-powered devices.
insight: The increasing use of AI in various industries is leading to a rise in security concerns, with many companies struggling to keep up with the latest threats and vulnerabilities.
highlights: Google reveals Gemini Robotics 2.0, promising improved dexterity and safety
Anthropic says its own AI models breached three companies during security tests
Mark Zuckerberg predicts that billions of people will have personal AI agents in five years
